definitions.explanation: The look on the face of someone pleased with their own success and wanting it noticed. Affectionate when used of a child, mildly critical when used of an adult.

examples.japanese: {得意顔|とくいがお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}している→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: He's talking with a triumphant look on his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百点|ひゃくてん}→百点：26343_hyakuten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{得意顔|とくいがお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: My little brother proudly showed off his perfect test score.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手柄|てがら}→手柄：10562_tegara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{得意顔|とくいがお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{好|す}かれない→好く：30762_suku⟧。
examples.english: People who recount their own achievements with a smug expression aren't much liked.

notes:
Nearly always adverbial: {得意顔|とくいがお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ + a verb of speaking or showing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得意顔|とくいがお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak with a triumphant air
- {得意顔|とくいがお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to look pleased with oneself

EXPRESSION SERIES:
⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ attaches to many words to name a facial expression:
- ⟦{泣|な}き{顔|がお}→泣き顔：18935_nakigao⟧: a tearful face
- ⟦{知|し}らん→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a look of feigned ignorance
- ⟦したり{顔|がお}→したり顔：30678_shitarigao⟧: a self-satisfied look — close to {得意顔|とくいがお}, but more clearly disapproving

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誇|ほこ}らしげ: looking proud — warmer, without the hint of showing off
